plain_english_revision: This amendment removes a general exemption for public employees from certain COVID-19 vaccine mandates, except where those mandates are tied to disciplinary hearings or proceedings. It does not address private-sector mandates or other healthcare-related provisions.
candidate_position_supported: Advances a policy that narrows the scope of COVID-19 vaccine exemptions for public employees to only those cases involving formal disciplinary hearings or proceedings
evidence_quotes: delete the following: , except those which involve a hearing
